author: Mirjam Iedema

text: This is a great app that is very customizable. The visual helps to keep you motivated. Once you keep your habit for a few days in a row you want to keep going to not interrupt the line of coloured blocks. If there'd be a way to pay for the pro version without sharing payment info with yt then I'd definitely do that. However the app developer is very generous and you can get a long way with the free version. Great app that deserves 5 ✴️ and the developer is very kind too. Clear recommendation!
author: Neva.

text: Could you please explain why it costs €21,99 for the premium version. I like the possibility of not having to pay a subscription but compared to other habit trackers €21,99 is still 2 to 3 times more expensive. I've tried it but I need more than 4 habits making it impossible to use it for my needs.
author: Oscar O'Beirne
developer_reply: Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. As a solo developer, I'm trying to find the right balance between providing value in the free version of the app, and sustaining the development and maintenance costs that allow me to continuously improve the app and provide a good user experience. Hope you like the app anyway!

text: Overzichtelijke, eenvoudige app die mij helpt mijn routines vol te houden. Geeft mij een goed beeld van alle routines en voltooide taken.
author: M. Lange
developer_reply: Thanks for the awesome review, Michelle! I really appreciate your support!

text: Handige reminder om (nieuw) gedrag aan te leren, bijvoorbeeld 'iedere ochtend 15 minuten rugoefeningen doen'.
author: L. Dam

text: Easy to use. You can also track habits multiple times a day and the color block becomes stronger in color the more you complete it in a day. This helped me a lot especially in the first weeks of a new habit, because if i havent had the perfect day i dont immediately lose my streak if i at least tried my best. In time you can ofc see if this happens too often. Another plus is that even with a free account you can use 4 habits. And no irritating ads👍
